capabilities: Structure notes as a DAG via frontmatter parent links with cycle validation
Chat with AI providers using answers grounded in locally retrieved notes with inline citations
Visualize the thought graph with layouts, filters, path highlighting, and a growth timeline
Generate typed follow-up questions for the active note
Suggest tags, statuses, titles, and parent links with AI
extras: Desktop only. Installable via BRAT. Graph, search, similarity, and note management work without an API key; only chat and AI suggestions need one. Roadmap items (Canvas export, graph import/export) are not yet implemented.
problem: Obsidian notes are flat files whose graph view shows raw links, with no hierarchy of thoughts and no AI chat that answers from your own notes.
